World State 37/100 (Unsettled) · 13 Alert · 42 Watch · 34 Normal Headline: The US–Iran war still drives the board: a seafarer was killed on a Gulf tanker on 5 Nov and Trump says a strike decision is near. Brent and food prices eased to Watch; DR Congo's cholera toll rises alongside Ebola.
## Situations (7 cross-domain events; Alerts below are grouped under them) - US–Iran war and Gulf energy shock [ALERT, stable]: Seafarer killed on a tanker hit off Qatar on 5 Nov; Iran sends a proposal via Qatar as Trump weighs new strikes. Brent near $98. → alert: gulf-iran, middle-east, eu-gas, chokepoints, freight; watch: iran-nuclear, sanctions, oil, fertiliser, uk-energy-cap, semiconductors - Russia–Ukraine war and NATO's flank [ALERT, stable]: Russia hits Ukraine's grid and a Kharkiv postal hub on 5 Nov; Ukraine strikes Ryazan refinery; NATO warns Poland of border provocations. → alert: russia-ukraine; watch: russia-nato, nuclear-plants - Super El Niño [ALERT, worsening]: ONI +2.5 for Aug–Oct; record warmth for the date on 31 Oct; El Niño drought hits crops in southern Africa and South-east Asia. → alert: enso, global-temp; watch: drought, co2, famine - Ebola outbreak, DR Congo [ALERT, worsening]: ECDC counted 10,668 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,198 deaths in DR Congo to 3 Nov; a WHO PHEIC since May. → alert: ebola; watch: who-emergencies - Sudan war [ALERT, worsening]: Drone strikes knock out Sudan's power grid; army says it intercepted 180 drones; a fuel-station strike killed at least 7 on 4 Nov. → alert: sudan; watch: famine - France: debt stress and protests [ALERT, stable]: OAT–Bund spread about 153bp on 6 Nov; Fitch outlook negative on 3 Nov; 600,000+ marched on 5 Nov; budget deadline 17 Nov. → alert: sovereign-debt; watch: civil-unrest - Energy shock feeding inflation [WATCH, worsening]: Bank of England raised Bank Rate to 4% on 5 Nov; euro-area inflation hit 4.0% in October and ECB officials signal more hikes. → watch: us-inflation, central-banks, uk-rates, bond-volatility, gilts; normal: em-stress
